scientific_integrity: Proof includes full-parameter analytic maximization. A symbolic checker independently computes algebraic identities and finite rational checks, not an external certification.
scientific_limitations: The sharp result treats only the two-dimensional repeated-pole subspace at real radius 0 <= r <= 1/2; no full degree-two rational embedding or r > 1/2 assertion. Independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
title: Exact Wiener-to-Hardy norm on the double-pole model space up to half radius
